title: Platform signal detector: dynamic baselining for cost/latency/usage spikes
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a resilient signal-detection service in the Console backend that automatically discovers and alerts on unusual usage, cost, and latency deviations. This ticket scopes the core detection algorithm and end-to-end plumbing from usage telemetry ingestion to routed alert notifications. The goal is to reduce undetected escalations for customers and provide high-quality signals with low false positive rates so SRE/CS can act quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Service consumes production usage metrics from Kafka topic 'usage.metrics.v2' and produces alerts to 'alerts.signals.v1'
Dynamic baseline calculation runs continuously with a 5m latency target for signal emission
False positive rate on historical replay < 4% and precision > 90% for top-3 cost-impacting customers in the test cohort
Alert routing respects team ownership (team_id) and integrates with PagerDuty, Slack, and Console notification rules
Rate limiting and suppression policies prevent alert storms during upstream incidents
Documentation and runbook created in Confluence and linked from the ticket
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Offline replay and model selection - run seasonal decomposition (Holt-Winters) + EWMA + robust z-score on 12 months of metrics to pick default heuristics
Phase 2: Streaming runner - Flink job (or ksql/Flink-lite) that maintains per-entity baselines and emits signals with metadata (baseline, anomaly_score, contributor_dimensions)
Phase 3: Attribution layer - map cost deltas to org->workspace->route using existing billing join service
Phase 4: Notification router - Console backend service to translate signals into Alerts with suppression windows and escalation paths
Phase 5: Canary rollout (10% of workspaces), iterate thresholds, then global ramp
technical_notes: Input telemetry: tokenized usage and latency histograms are consumed from Kafka 'usage.metrics.v2' and enriched with customer metadata from the metadata cache
Baseline algorithm: hybrid approach - Holt-Winters for diurnal/weekly seasonality + EWMA for drift + robust MAD-based thresholds to be resilient to spikes
State storage: RocksDB keyed state in Flink; fallback to Redis for light-weight per-entity summaries for low-latency lookups
Anomaly scoring: combine z-score, relative pct change, and cost-weighted impact to prioritize alerts (score is a weighted sum, tunable via feature flags)
Suppression: backoff-based suppression with exponential decay and manual silencing via Console; support for grouping by customer and model endpoint
Privacy: only aggregated counters emitted in alerts; PII scrubbed in enrichment joins; billing IDs hashed where necessary
testing_plan: Historical replay harness against 18 months of usage and billing data to compute precision/recall for candidate rules
Synthetic spike generator to validate detection latency and suppression behavior under rapid event storms
Integration tests for Kafka consumer/producer, end-to-end signal flow, and notification router (PagerDuty & Slack mocks)
Load test the Flink job to ensure state scaling for 50k active partitions and verify <5m catch-up on restart
rollout_plan: Canary: enable for 10% of production workspaces filtered by volume tiers for 7 days - monitor FP rate and mean time to detect
Adjust thresholds via feature flags and promote tuned config to 50% for another 7 days
Full rollout after meeting SLOs for precision/recall and Ops checklist signoff
Provide opt-out for customers and a manual 'quiet mode' for maintenance windows
monitoring_slo: Detection latency: 95th percentile <= 300s from metric ingestion to alert emission
False positives: <4% on replay cohort; operational target <3% after tuning
Alert storm protection: no more than 20 alerts/min per org by default (configurable)
